title: L CON and Foundling
description:
L CON is the ever-evolving project of Lisa Conway - a Swiss-Canadian sonic adventurer, songwriter, composer, researcher, recordist, and mixer based in Montréal. Her work is often minimalist, and blends analog synthesizers, tape machines, and electronics with acoustic instruments. Lisa is an alumni of the final Red Bull Music Academy (Berlin 2018), with recent album releases on Toronto labels Halocline Trance and Idée Fixe. She has received press from publications like Musicworks (cover fall 2025), The Fader, the CBC, BOMB Magazine, Exclaim, and Earmilk, and has collaborated on works presented at TIFF, the D'Haus (Dusseldorf), MaerzMusik (Berlin), The Harbourfront Centre, Hot Docs, and the Inside Out Festival. A graduate of the MA in Sonic Arts from Queen’s University Belfast, she is currently pursuing a SSHRC-funded Individualized PhD in Fine Arts (sound studies) at Concordia University.

Foundling is the project of Canadian-born, Berlin-based composer, harpist, and vocalist Erin
Lang, and drummer percussionist Constantine Karlis (NZ), and hosts many collaborations, 
presenting immersive live performances that move fluidly between composition and improvisation. 
Centred on their recent album Artemisia, (Shadow World Records UK) Foundling’s 
current concerts unfold through harp, voice, and percussion in slowly evolving forms,
where structured motifs dissolve into open, intuitive passages with voice and spoken word, 
drawing from ambient, experimental new age, and psychedelic folk traditions. 
Foundling’s live work offers intimate, emotionally resonant performances that delicately 
explore more mystical depths. Lang has toured extensively across Europe and North America,
including performances at a very wide range of venues including the Berlin and Paris Philharmonies, 
Le Grand Rex and Le Trianon in Paris all the way to alternative arts and experimental DIY spaces. For Fans of Harold Budd, Grouper, Nala Sinephro, Midori Takada, and Laraaji.

Ignore The Machine (hanno leichtmann / nils ostendorf)
description:
A new duo from Berlin. By and featuring Hanno Leichtmann and Nils Ostendorf. Both are seasoned musicians with eventful careers who operate within very different artistic spheres.

One of them, Hanno Leichtmann, is a veteran—and remains to this day a pioneer—of the electronic music scene that has developed in Germany’s capital since the years following the fall of the Berlin Wall, thanks to projects such as Static, the Trio Groupshow, and countless collaborations.

The other, Nils Ostendorf, plays a trumpet whose capabilities are expanded through the use of various devices. He comes more from the world of contemporary jazz and has been a sought-after musician and composer on theater stages for years.

Hanno Leichtmann and Nils Ostendorf both use—at different times of the day, in rapid succession—a recording studio in the Wedding district filled with hand-picked instruments and equipment.

When the two met at the same time in that studio in May 2026, the plan was actually just to record a series of tracks for a release by Chromacolor, another solo project by Hanno Leichtmann.

It all went faster than planned. In the end, they still had some studio time together. The result was a completely unplanned, 60-minute-long improvisation. All recorded in real time.  The six tracks featured here were created through precise and decisive edits to the improvised and recorded material. Without any overdubs added afterward.  The result is music that is open, exploratory, and not bound exclusively to any one genre. It has no qualms about engaging with the world of tonality and musical figuration. The boundaries and overlaps between ambient and jazz, free improvisation and musique concrète are blurred and constantly renegotiated. 

All the semantics and moods found here are, in principle, unstable. Every state reached is transitory. One thing leads to another. We perceive and imagine spaces of possibility that are becoming increasingly rare in the material world.  Ignore The Machine’s debut is the first release on Hanno Leichtmann’s new label, Semen Contra. It is available exclusively as a limited-edition CD. Each release includes an art print from the label head’s extensive image library.

title: Domingo Fantástico VIII with Verde Lejos and Fernanda Tarrech
description:
I am pleased to present a new edition of Domingo Fantástico, the music and variety series held at Donau115. Inspired by the great weekend television shows that shaped generations across Latin America and Spain, this event celebrates diversity, creativity, and cultural exchange in Berlin.

In this edition, we will explore the musical paths that connect Ibero-America and Europe through artists who have made Berlin a space for creation, exchange, and sonic experimentation.

The evening will feature Verde Lejos, a Berlin-based musical project that brings together artists from across Ibero-America to create a global sound. Their music combines Latin American spirit with influences from soul, groove, contemporary electronics, and alternative rock, creating a musical universe that is both danceable and introspective.

We will also welcome guest artist Fernanda Tarrech, a singer-songwriter born in Montevideo, Uruguay. After beginning her musical journey busking in the streets of her hometown and releasing her first EP, La primera revolución de los pájaros, she moved to Germany, where she has continued to develop an artistic path marked by openness, curiosity, and a close connection with audiences. In recent years she has shared stages with artists such as Paul Wetz, Bukahara, and Manu Chao while preparing her upcoming recordings.

An evening dedicated to music that travels, transforms, and finds new homes.

title: Jessie Monk Trio
description:
Jessie Monk is an artist devoted to making space for the old ways in the new world - through song, story and ritual. Drawing inspiration from the folk traditions of her gaelic-ancestry, Naarm-based artist is obsessed with old myths, poetry, stories and songs from various traditions and lineages throughout the ages. Weaving them amongst new threads of jazz/experimental sounds, Jessie and band create an atmosphere of tangible and, at the same time, experimental folklore, enchanting audiences with soaring and mystical compositions filled with poetry, symbol, dreams and humanity.

Coming from a theatrical background, she learnt a lot from performing in the Australian Premier of David Bowie’s, Lazarus and the Australian tour of Anais Mitchell’s, Hadestown. In 2023, she released her debut album, Continually Becoming, regarded as ‘Boundless Folk' by Rolling Stone Magazine - and is now touring her sophomore album - Mis O’ The Mountains - a concept album based on the myth of an ancient celtic goddess named Mis, which was nominated for AFMA’s Contemporary Folk Album of the Year, 2025. She has headlined many a Europe and UK tour and been lucky enough to support other wonderful artists like Rachel Sermanni, Ocie Elliot and Matthew and the Atlas.

title: PETER GALL // SOLO SHOW
description:
PETER GALL // SOLO SHOW
solo drums, beats, synth scapes plus material from the brand new album DRUM SEEDS

"Many of today’s jazz drummers are somehow different – ideally like Peter Gall," says Germany’s largest jazz magazine, Jazzthing.

Berlin-based drummer, composer, and producer Peter Gall is widely regarded as one of the leading German jazz drummers of his generation.

After studying jazz drums in Berlin and New York, he has performed with internationally acclaimed artists and ensembles across Europe and beyond. As an in-demand studio musician, Peter has contributed to more than 50 albums, working across jazz, pop, and indie music. He also serves as Professor of Jazz Drums at the Mannheim University of Music and Performing Arts.

His latest album, LOVE AVATAR, was awarded the German Jazz Prize 2025 for ALBUM OF THE YEAR.
There’s already a lot of buzz surrounding his brand-new album DRUM SEEDS, which puts the drums and original beats in the spotlight. But that’s only how it seems at first glance. Peter Gall’s new solo album is much more than just a drum statement.

In his solo show, he presents solo drums and improvisation, with a strong focus on irresistible grooves and trippy beats with a highly emotional and human pulse, alongside material from his latest release DRUM SEEDS (+ very new stuff). Although this is a one-man show with the drums at its center, it also features song-like structures with deep harmonies, catchy melodies and hooklines, and sometimes even orchestral soundscapes that open up new worlds, paired with a great deal of melancholy.

Come out and be surprised!

title: Bleu Reine & Drunk at Your Wedding
description:
A German-French friendship: Bleu Reine hails from the greater Paris area, while Drunk at Your Wedding comes from Berlin. They met in 2024 at a Berlin open mic during Bleu Reine’s last European tour. In 2025, Drunk at Your Wedding got to crash on a couch and perform a living-room concert in Paris. In 2026, the two singer-songwriters are touring Germany together.

Musically, they share a heart rooted in folk and grunge: dark, melodic, and at times volatile. Bleu Reine’s beats hypnotically and layered, interwoven with delicate electronic elements. Songs like shadowy dreamscapes to get lost in. Drunk at Your Wedding sounds more stripped-back and direct. Sometimes loud, sometimes introspective. With a lyrical range spanning everything from musical adaptations of poetry to real-life plane crashes, occasionally even making you laugh.

Paris – Berlin: on the same wavelength, yet operating at different frequencies. Une parfaite liason musicale!

title: David Preston / Antoine Pierre / Lukas Traxel
description:
**David Preston** is a London-born guitarist and composer, now based between London and Berlin. A finalist in the 2009 Montreux International Guitar Competition, he has performed and recorded with artists including Melody Gardot, Lianne La Havas, Kit Downes and Sebastian Rochford. His own music, released on Whirlwind Recordings, combines modern jazz with an adventurous, highly melodic approach.

**Antoine Pierre** is a Belgian drummer and composer and a major figure on the European jazz scene. Leader of URBEX and Next.Ape, he has worked with musicians including Philip Catherine, Joshua Redman, Ben Wendel and Tom Barman’s TaxiWars. His playing combines a powerful rhythmic approach with a broad interest in jazz, rock and electronic music.

**Lukas Traxel** is a Swiss double bassist and a graduate of the Lucerne University of Music. He has worked extensively across the European jazz scene with artists including Marie Krüttli, Christoph Grab, Tal Arditi and Lea Maria Fries, and is a member of the Lucerne Jazz Orchestra. His debut album *One-Eyed Daruma* was released by We Jazz in 2023.

Odd Steinar Albrigtsen is an exciting Norwegian guitarist/ composer who currently lives in Oslo as a jazz musician. Fall 2026 Odd Albrigtsen 4tet embarks on tour with their latest album Winds. 
The band members met in New York after an exciting musical encounter and has since been on several tours and played concerts in Norway and Europe. Albrigtsen has earlier released the albums Mode, Morse and The North under his own name with critical acclaim.The album Winds was recorded in Barcelona after a tour in Spain. The Former album Morse Featuring Chris Cheek was recorded 2017 that also features, Gianni Gagliardi, Chris Cheek, Lars Ekman and Jesse Simpson.

Albrigtsen was born in the northern city of Tromsø, Norway ( 1985) and began playing drums at the age of 6 before switching to the guitar. Odd Steinar Albrigtsen started to study jazz at the conservatory in Trondheim, Norway. He then lived in Oslo and played with the great musicians on the Scandinavian jazz scene and after that he went to study at Aaron Copland School of Music in New York where he studied with great american jazz musicians such as Michael Mossman, David Berkman Paul Bollenbeck and Lage Lund.

title: TSOMBANIS4
description: Tsombanis4, the quartet founded by the renowned tenor saxophonist Anna Tsombanis, is causing a sensation with its unusual line-up. With two double basses, saxophone and drums, the composer, who is known for her preference for low notes, explores the sound possibilities of the lower register and gives it plenty of space. She is joined by the Swiss bassist Andreas Waelti and the Austrian bassistist Beate Wiesinger, whose different timbres harmonise perfectly and complement each other. The ensemble is carried by drummer Herbert Pirker, whose energetic playing has a lasting impact on the sound of the quartet, while Anna Tsombanis explores new spheres with her full and warm tenor sound. The result is an explosive mixture of spontaneous communication and energetic playing in which the roots of traditional jazz can still be clearly felt.

title: Dina Maccabee
description: Dina Maccabee's sound blends the warmth of folk-pop with experimental mischief. Her latest album LMNO, out October 16 on Protomaterial Records, is a self-made balm for healing from cross-cultural COVID isolation, trying out every recipe from dark humor to entranced meditation. Known for live touring as a violist and vocalist with forward looking acts like Julia Holter and for recording credits with inspiring creators like Shearwater, TuneYards, and Feist, her songs surf between playfully sardonic bangers and unguardedly earnest love odes.

title: Hans Bilger
description:
HANS BILGER is a Berlin-based musician, sound engineer, and bioacoustician.

He is currently the composer-in-residence at Cora Dance (USA) and has released original albums of songs and compositions on Good Child Music (Meridian, 2019) and Adhyâropa Records (Orchids, 2025, with Eli Greenhoe). A trained double bassist and omnivorous improviser (he studied with members of the Staatskapelle Berlin and collaborators of Ornette Coleman), he has performed across Europe and the USA with bluegrass bands, jazz groups, Syrian takht ensembles, songwriters, and indie rock bands.

As a recording engineer and producer, Bilger has worked across a wide range of genres and contexts — from symphony orchestras to modernist duos, traditional Romanian song to electroacoustic flute pieces. He has worked on production teams for recordings on ECM Records and his engineering work has been featured on Apple Music's Best New Songs. His studio, Two Fields Sound, is based in Berlin's historic Funkhaus. He has taught courses on recording and artist development at Bard College Berlin and Universität der Künste. He is currently a staff sound engineer at Berlin’s historic A-Trane jazz club.

Bilger also has a deep background in the science of sound. He holds a doctorate in evolutionary bioacoustics from the University of Texas at Austin and has published research on the musicality of birdsong and the evolution of the voice in frogs, bats, and humans in journals such as Frontiers in Psychology and Bioacoustics. Currently, these interests are feeding a new project: We Beasties, a children's literature and music radio play exploring the perceptual worlds of different animals.

At Donau115, he will play a combination of original songs and arrangements featuring voice, double bass, oud, and guitar.

title: Little North (DK) feat. Reinier Baas (NL) & Hannes Bennich (SE)
description:
Crossing Currents is Little North’s upcoming album on the renowned German label ACT Music
and marks a new chapter for the Danish trio. With six albums released since 2020, Little North
has established itself as a distinctive and independent voice on the European jazz scene.

Little North works first and foremost as a collective. All members are composers and draw
inspiration from a wide spectrum of genres and musical traditions. Curiosity, both shared and
individual, is the driving force, and each album explores its own musical territory.

Crossing Currents was created in New York in a meeting between the trio, vibraphonist Joel
Ross (US), and saxophonist Hannes Bennich (SE). Little North’s Nordic sound and poetic
precision merge with the energy of the international jazz scene, resulting in an open and
contemporary expression where musical currents from Copenhagen, New York, and Malmö
meet.

Live, the music gains a new dimension through vibrant interplay with the Dutch guitarist Reinier
Baas (NL). Reinier Baas is one of Europe’s most original guitar voices and is known for his
rhythmic mastery and melodic inventiveness. Together with Hannes Bennich, the material is
continuously developed in the moment, taking new forms from concert to concert.

For the audience, this means a concert experience that cannot be heard on the album. The music
is created in the moment in the meeting between the musicians, the space, and the listeners and
builds bridges between the Danish and international jazz scenes.

title: Synesthetic4
description:
The Austrian quartet Synesthetic4 was founded in 2017 by Peter Rom and Vincent Pongracz. Their debut album Pickendem won the German Record Critics' Award, and in 2024 the ensemble was awarded the first Austrian Jazz Prize. Their fourth studio album, „Bread“, is now being released.
Bands that collaborate over an extended period and regularly release music often face the question of whether to venture into new territory, delve deeper into familiar themes without repeating themselves, or simply deliberately repeat themselves.

Synesthetic4's last album, "Ahwowha" (2023), was compositionally clearly an uncompromising,
conceptual deepening of ideas that had already surfaced in their debut album Pickedem, with a strong focus on post-production. This gradual intensification of themes is clearly broken with Bread. Vincent Pongracz's compositions offer a breath of fresh air by distancing themselves from internalized structures and established concepts, placing complete trust in groove, feeling, and
simplicity of ideas without imposing conceptual constructs on them. With these new pieces, Pongracz takes the risk of sounding naive.

During the recording, emphasis was placed on making music together. The four musicians played
together in a room without click track or headphones.

Synesthetic4 – Milestones:
• Preis der Deutschen Schallplattenkritik für das Album Pickedem (2019)
• Österreichischer Jazzpreis in der Kategorie „Best Live Act“ (2024)
• Nominierung für den Deutschen Jazzpreis (2025, mit dem Synesthetic Octet)
• Nominierung für den AMADEUS AUstrian Music Award (2026)


„…die große Entdeckung des Festivals…“ — Tom Gsteiger
“…less well known but more groundbreaking… pushed the boundary between rap and scat.” — Wif Stenger, JazzJournal (UK)

title: Matthieu Mazué “Turn of Events” feat Francisco Mela and Diego Hedez
description:
A new project initiated in New York City by pianist Matthieu Mazué, “Turn of Events” brings
together three musicians with strong and distinct musical visions, each widely recognized for their
exceptional improvisational talents. Alongside Mazué is drummer Francisco Mela, a major figure
on the contemporary jazz scene who has performed with McCoy Tyner and Kenny Barron, and
trumpeter Diego Hedez, a regular collaborator of bassist William Parker.
Together, they explore new sonic territories within a deliberately bassless formation — an artistic
choice that frees the piano from its traditionally codified harmonic role. This absence opens the
way to a more transparent sound and a lighter, freer approach to the instrument. The dialogue
between piano and drums becomes a central pillar — not only supporting the trumpet but also
redefining the piano’s traditional role as accompanist. The drums, in turn, unfold with remarkable
rhythmic freedom, shaping the contours of improvisation with flexibility and inventiveness.

TRYON
description:
TRYON is conceived as a living ensemble—one that brings together New York–based performers and improvisers to realise new and unreleased works composed in Berlin, Germany. At its core, the project seeks to create a dialogue between European experimental composition practices and the deep improvisational traditions of New York, with free improvisation serving as a foundational and unifying element.

TRYON will be performing music from their new upcoming album "Salmon Dreams". 
TRYON have released two albums on Double Moon Records. “Läuterung” which was released with a 13 piece ensemble in 2022 comprised of: Ganna Gryniva, Erik Leuthäuser, Omri Abramov, Toms Rudzinskis; and in 2023 “Freaky Squash Baby” which was released as an 18 piece group featuring: Kiki Manders, Mirna Bogdanovic, Erik Leuthäuser, Oli Steidle, Taiko Saito, Rieko Okuda, Philipp Gropper, Jasper Stadhouders, and many more.

TRYON has performed as both large and small ensemble versions in:

Jazzexzess, Jazzam Kaistersteg, VIllingen Jazzclub, Freakshow Artrock Festival, Ponava Jazz Festival, Improdimensija Concert Series, Nordhausen Jazzclub,  M//Darbnica, Kaunas Jazz Academy, Donau115, Bflat, Jazzclub Schlot, Terminus Saarbrucken, Saxstall, Kultūras nams Wiktorija, LOFT, and many more.

“Jazz rock and rock sounds and rhythms can at one point morph into jazz avant-garde or emotional and even tender statements. At other moments, the musicians play intellectually and sonically demanding or meet at a certain point on the level of the classic jazz form. There are no rules here. There is a wonderful, seemingly spontaneous game. You just have to listen to this album.”
